| The seven default shelves are the seven default shelves (110) | — no check named in the section |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (117) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (294) |
| Every note has at least one address (130) | every note reachable from the vault is on at least one shelf (307) |
| A book opens on its oldest note (138) | date contents default to oldest and saved newest settings remain readable (373) |
| A note with no date of its own (147) | a note with no date of its own takes the earliest stamp the file has (391) |
| Undated is a book, not a guess (161) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (320) |
| The ISO week keeps its week-year (176) | an ISO week keeps its week-year across a January boundary (428) |
| The Encyclopedia opens with 0-9 (185) | the Encyclopedia opens with a 0-9 volume, not ten one-note books (444) |
| Plaques are date-only and asked for (193) | year plaques only appear on date classifiers, and only when asked for (455); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (472); years group under decade plaques, and a run that wraps is named on both rows (901) |

| An impossible date is not a date (338) | an impossible date is not a date, and never a fifteenth month (332) |
| Book addresses are stable across a rebuild (356) | book addresses are stable across a rebuild (1210) |
| Filters change membership and nothing else (362) | a filter changes membership without moving a shelf (1221) |

| The Favourites shelf holds references, and only references (419) | Favourites comes first and empty, fresh and by migration from schema 9 (1487); a drop onto Favourites adds the book where it landed, and a rebuild keeps it (1553); a favourite comes off by the menu, and a dead pick is dropped on save and not before (1713); a favourite dragged off the shelf comes off, and a cancelled drag does not (1792); a second favourites shelf is built from the builder and holds its own books (1905); a note in two favourites is one note on the shelf (2006); a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (294) |
| A book made on the shelf is a saved query, and a place a note lives (494) | a book made on the shelf holds the notes it points at, where it was made (2037); a look is opt-in, repaints everything and moves nothing (3965); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (6907); a made book is edited, emptied and deleted from its own menu, and the vault does not move (2260); a book is made on any shelf arranged by hand, and a plus stands where the books end (2416) |
